card.name: Verb after existential 'there'
card.fires_on: Strongest on 'have' right after 'there' in 'there have been' in general web prose. Weaker, scattered hits on other mid-sentence words such as 'can', 'risk', 'type' and 'important'.

card.plain: It lights up on the 'have' in 'there have been' and, less strongly, on some other words in mid-sentence.
